title: Simulating Two-Sided Job Marketplaces with AI Agents

contributions.purpose: 提供可复现的双边劳动力市场仿真环境
contributions.mechanism: GPT-4o-mini 智能体 + 自适应提示 + 多层声誉系统 + 纵向行为追踪,开源(github.com/upwork/simploy)
contributions.evaluation: 5 配置 x 20 次重复,200 自由职业者+30 客户 x 100 轮;定性框架贡献,无单一效果数字
contributions.source_quote: We provide a controlled environment for LLM-agent interactions that integrates adaptive prompting, a multi-tier reputation system, and longitudinal behavior tracking.

contributions.purpose: 提供可解释的分析工具箱
contributions.mechanism: 对比实验设计 + 不平等指标(Gini) + 决策日志/反思捕获 + 复合市场健康指数
contributions.evaluation: 支持策略与结果的联合分析;作者自承市场健康分在策略型vs量型对比时会误导(偏向 fill rate)
contributions.source_quote: We contribute an integrated set of analytical components for LLM-based simulations, including comparative experimental design, inequality metrics (e.g., Gini coefficients), explicit reasoning capture through decision logs, reflection-based adaptation, and composite market health indicators.

contributions.purpose: 实证揭示认知架构如何驱动市场结果
contributions.mechanism: 跨 5 配置对比 + 反思消融
contributions.evaluation: 反思使 fill rate 43.5%→69.3%、Gini 0.50→0.29,但 per-bid 效率反降(32.2%→25.1%);选择性错配的混合配置崩溃(Rand-F+LLM-C 仅 38.6% fill/5.5% eff)
contributions.source_quote: We demonstrate the framework through systematic experiments across five configurations, revealing how cognitive architecture differences drive selectivity alignment effects, fundamental trade-offs between efficiency and equity, and the crucial role of adaptation mechanisms in market outcomes.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our framework draws on these ingredients but targets longitudinal strategic evolution in a labor-style marketplace, with explicit logging of natural-language reasoning to enable mechanism-level analysis beyond outcome aggregates.

notes: 三条自声明贡献(§1.1)。核心 trade-off 有数字:反思提升 fill/公平但降 per-bid 效率(25.1% vs 32.2%,约 1.3 vs 2.9 bids/job)。作者自曝市场健康分会误导。统计诚实:承认多重比较未做校正、有 Type I 风险(§6)。checklist AI 披露高(Hypothesis=D,其余 C,AI 主导写作/实现)。自曝 AI 局限:引用幻觉、不更新实现只生成新代码。数据无明显造假红旗:随机基线参数(5% bid/50% accept)明确标注为噪声地板。质量整体扎实,与 accept 一致。
